notes: Six-hour agent timeout (override_timeout_sec=21600) on the fixed-QEMU TB2.1 snapshot; a modified evaluation, not a leaderboard-eligible configuration.

bench-run cohort on HF Jobs (Harbor b20373d6) with the published fast-agent-mcp 0.10.43 wheel; Claude Haiku 5.5 (low reasoning) through GitHub Copilot. Zero whole-trial retries; fast-agent's own provider retries apply. No infrastructure failures, so no replacements. One gpt2-codegolf trial whose agent process was killed without explanation is kept as an outcome, as is one verifier timeout.
Safety stops: 4 trials ended with AgentSafetyStopError, all sparql-university; the verifier still passed all four, so they count as passes here (bench-run's stricter rule counts them 0: 352/445).

Cost shown is a list-rate estimate repriced from each trial's token usage (bench-run reprice, card-packs catalog 2026-10-10.1): Harbor's fast-agent adapter charged prompt-cache writes as plain input. Recorded $9.80; repriced $10.15 over the same 445 trials. The run used GitHub Copilot, so this is a list-price equivalent, not what Copilot billed.
